items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Warner Carter, Warren Jefferson, and I just can't recall the other trumpet player... We had some very good musicians as far as reading and arranging on that band.

ctx.x: Elton Hill, Warren Jefferson, Warner Carter, trumpet player. He had about five or six. A piano player used to be with the band, he wrote -- Garnett Clark, the young guy I mentioned. And he had about six or seven real pretty good
